The '''Spurs of Celanon''' were a pair of ancient spur routes in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that connected worlds along what would be the future [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]]. The spur originated from [[Celanon/Legends|Celanon]] and snaked its way toward [[Vinsoth/Legends|Vinsoth]], before doubling back to Axxila and terminating at [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]].
